metadata.description: wamra's Claude Code plugins — language servers and code-intelligence tooling

plugins.name: powershell-lsp
plugins.description: PowerShell language server for Claude Code via Microsoft's PowerShell Editor Services (PSES) — cross-file definitions, references, hover, rename for .ps1/.psm1/.psd1. Auto-installs PSES on first run; macOS, Linux, Windows.

plugins.name: session-index
plugins.description: Lossless, searchable index of your Claude Code sessions: hooks keep it current, a skill searches it. Binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows are bundled.

plugins.name: session-index-search
plugins.description: Search and read archived sessions inside Claude Code: search and show tools and a /sessions command. Binaries bundled.

plugins.name: code-index-search
plugins.description: Semantic code index for a repo: search and show tools and a /code command, plus a code-search skill. Binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows are bundled.
